g.text: Residual = a target occurrence still classified correctly by the detector after attack.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253641

g.text: Below each bin: L = learned, R = random; residual occurrences / evaluated occurrences.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253641

g.text: Bin boundaries come from training metadata; displayed decimals are rounded. Axes use different scales.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253641

g.text: Exploratory association: degree and budget are confounded. Checkpoints were selected on these validation groups.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253641

g.text: Counts pool three seed passes; occurrences repeat across groups and seeds. Denominators are exposures, not independent sample sizes.
